import time
import torch

from solver import solve_mckp_constrained, uniform_quantization_baseline, enforce_monotonicity

MAX_2BIT = 8
NUM_SAMPLES = 64
SEQ_LEN = 2048
OUTPUT_FILE = "c4_cross_dataset_eval_v2_results.json"


def build_calibration_ids_concat(path, tokenizer, num_samples, seq_len, device):
    """Load C4 JSON, concatenate all texts, split into non-overlapping chunks."""
    with open(path) as f:
        samples = json.load(f)
    text = "\n\n".join(s["text"] if isinstance(s, dict) else s for s in samples)
    token_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
    chunks = []
    for i in range(0, len(token_ids) - seq_len + 1, seq_len):
        chunks.append(token_ids[i:i + seq_len])
        if len(chunks) >= num_samples:
            break
    actual = len(chunks)
    if actual < num_samples:
        print(f"  WARNING: only got {actual}/{num_samples} sequences (total tokens={len(token_ids)})", flush=True)
    if not chunks:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No calibration seqs with >= {seq_len} tokens from concatenated text")
    return torch.tensor(chunks, dtype=torch.long, device=device), actual


def load_wt2_reference():
    with open(WT2_REF_FILE) as f:

    for r in data["results"]:

    raise ValueError(f"No budget={BUDGET} entry in {WT2_REF_FILE}")

    keys = set(alloc_a.keys()) & set(alloc_b.keys())
    if not keys:

    agree = 0
    disagree_details = {}
    for k in sorted(keys):
        a_type, a_param = alloc_a[k]
        b_type, b_param = alloc_b[k]
        if a_type == b_type and a_param == b_param:
            agree += 1
        else:
            disagree_details[k] = {"wt2": [a_type, a_param], "c4": [b_type, b_param]}
    return agree / len(keys), disagree_details
